passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My grandmother makes cookies in her warm kitchen.
phrases.ko: 나의 할머니는 따뜻한 부엌에서 쿠키를 만들어요.

phrases.en: She likes to knit, and she makes a soft sweater.
phrases.ko: 할머니는 뜨개질을 좋아하고, 부드러운 스웨터를 만들어요.

phrases.en: We drink tea together on Sunday.
The cookies are sweet, and I love them.
She lives on the farm with my grandfather.
I visit her because her kitchen feels like home.
phrases.ko: 할머니 부엌은 집처럼 느껴져서 나는 할머니를 보러 가요.

phrases.en: She knits slowly and talks with me.
phrases.ko: 할머니는 천천히 뜨개질을 하면서 나와 이야기해요.

phrases.en: My little sister sits beside her.
We smile together when the cookies are ready.
phrases.ko: 쿠키가 준비되면 우리는 함께 미소를 지어요.

phrases.en: I love my grandmother very much.

full_passage_spoken: My grandmother makes cookies in her warm kitchen. She likes to knit, and she makes a soft sweater. We drink tea together on Sunday. She has a kind smile. The cookies are sweet, and I love them. She lives on the farm with my grandfather. I visit her because her kitchen feels like home. She knits slowly and talks with me. My little sister sits beside her. We smile together when the cookies are ready. I love my grandmother very much.
